purpose: Judge-independent held-out confirmation of PRME memory utility against the official no-memory baseline

selection.excluded_reason: Questions inspected by any earlier LongMemEval-V2 smoke, diagnosis, or recovery run are excluded before answer generation.

reader.profile_classification: local development reader; not the prescribed leaderboard serving stack

protocol.question_order: released dataset order after the registered filter
protocol.answer_generation: PRME first, then the no-memory baseline, with no code or configuration changes after observing PRME outcomes
protocol.checkpointing: Durable exact-request checkpoint launcher; all failures and UNKNOWN answers are retained
primary_metrics: overall and per-category exact score for each system
paired wins and losses versus no memory
protocol.stopping_rule: Run every registered question for both systems; do not tune from intermediate or final outcomes. Infrastructure failures may be resumed from exact checkpoints.
protocol.claim_boundary: This is a broad held-out development confirmation for deterministic web-small questions. It excludes judge-dependent categories, enterprise, prescribed-server reproduction, and other published memory baselines.
